recent_en: On 25 November 2026, Vantris Energy announced that its subsidiary secured offshore transportation and installation (T&I) work orders worth up to RM475 million from PETRONAS Carigali. The company released its quarterly financial results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on 29 September 2026, with revenue up 26.9% QoQ but net income down 48.4% QoQ. Additionally, the company changed its company secretary on 19 October 2026.
notable_en: Subsidiary secured offshore work orders worth up to RM475 million from PETRONAS Carigali.
The company changed its company secretary on 19 October 2026.
risks_en: Net income declined 48.4% QoQ, with net margin falling from 22.6% to 9.2%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM818.455 million, up 26.9% QoQ and 2.1% YoY; net income was RM75.302 million, down 48.4% QoQ, with net margin at 9.2% versus 22.6% in the previous quarter.
